name: Metropoolregio Brainport Eindhoven
verdict: A region-brand partnership run by Brainport Development N.V., owned by five Dutch regional and local governments. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Since 2019 the front of the PSV shirt has carried not a company name but the region brand 'Metropoolregio Brainport Eindhoven'; behind the one name stand seven premium partners (ASML, CSU, Jumbo, Philips, Royal Swinkels, VDL Groep and, since 2025, Rabobank). The operating company is owned by regional and local Dutch government, which on its own is not a rating; no sourced abuse record was found.
